image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) attached to a surface. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves) arranged in a linear series. These plates are greyish-green with vertical striations and dark central markings. The plates are surrounded by a thick, textured, brownish leathery girdle (mantle) that forms the outer border. The image appears to be a biological illustration or a high-resolution photograph of a specimen.
